chapter: Clarinet teachers and the Baton Rouge scene
title: Fritz's bands and his beautiful tone
summary: Fritz played with Augustin, Tody Harris and sometimes Toots; his tone was fluid, like Noone and unlike George Lewis.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Who did Isadore Fritz play with when he was teaching you? Do you know what band he played with?
Well, Fritz played with Augustin(?) and Tody(?) Harris, and sometimes he played with Toots.
George Lewis said, I think, I'm not a hundred percent sure... But I think he said that Fritz showed him a few things. Does what George Lewis plays sound anything like Isadore Fritz?

Different style and different tone altogether. I can remember Fritz had a beautiful tone on the clarinet. In fact, he really fascinated me moreso than even Jimmie Noone. But I really believed he played better. The guy was one of these guys that he didn't realize how good he was -- to me.
But the same kind of style or tone as Jimmie Noone more than George Lewis, shall we say.
Oh, beautiful. Much, much more fluid.
